title: 0280: LITERATURE AUDIT (as of 2026-04 state of the art) - the S-route class is exhausted; the 5.00x miss decomposes 1.60x (irreducible wall) x 3.1x (sup overhead)
summary: Fresh sweep of the explicit S-theory literature through the 2026 state of the art (arXiv 2604.05733, 2412.15470, 2510.14309, 2603.21490, 2402.04272, JNT 2021, CJS 2011, Trans 8571). FINDINGS: (1) Best unconditional explicit pointwise |S(t)| at t = 3.0002e12: the 0.11log t + 0.29log log t + 2.29 family (2024, [20,Cor.1] line) gives ~6.42; the 0.112/0.278/2.510 bound (T >= e) gives ~6.66; the HSXW-2022 machinery used by 0276 gives 6.86 - all 5.0-5.2x above the per-piece gate requirement c = 2.5821 after the triangle (piece ~12.9-13.3). (2) The 2024 R-vM improvement (arXiv 2412.15470, Fiori app., 0.10076log T + 0.24460log log T + 8.08344) is sharper asymptotically but WORSE at our heights (O(8.08) constant dominates below e^e^16-ish); no help. (3) S-difference forms: Conrey-Ghosh-Gonek give |S(T+H)-S(T)| <= (1/2+o(1)) log T/log log T UNDER RH (~4.1 at 3e12, GROWING in t) - conditional, above the gate, and the wrong asymptotic (growing vs the decaying gate); the Trans 8571 explicit 2nd/4th moments of S(t+h)-S(t) (h << 1/log T) are MEAN-VALUE results (positive-proportion statements), which cannot deliver a pointwise sup bound at all - and the pointwise sup is exactly what the configuration-independent gate needs. (4) The 2026 zero-free regions (1 - 1/(4.896 log t); 55.241 (log)^(2/3) (log log)^(1/3) form) stay near the right edge (sigma >= ~0.993 at our t) - the face at Re = 0.125227 is untouched, as always. (5) NO published sub-O(ln t) unit-scale pointwise S-difference bound exists (re-confirmed with 2024-2026 literature; the 0276 audit holds and is now the state of the art). DECOMPOSITION OF THE 5.00x MISS (new, for the record): 5.00 = 1.60 (the IRREDUCIBLE first-moment wall, 0278: cGate 2.5821 < dmain 4.1199 per-unit mean, ratio GROWS in t) x 3.1 (the SUP-OVERHEAD: published explicit S bounds carry 3.1-3.2x the first moment, the Conrey-Ghosh-class constant-chase territory). The irreducible factor cannot be engineered away by any constant sharpening; the sup-overhead factor is genuine research (explicit h = 1 S-theory at below-mean strength - never achieved in 100+ years, and impossible for a configuration-independent bound in principle per 0278). VERDICT: the S-route (and every published count-kernel) class is EXHAUSTED as of the 2026 literature. The face remains OPEN; the wall stands; NO RH CLAIM. Route (b) is terminal; this audit seals the record.
literature: Explicit |S(t)| (unconditional, T >= e): |S(T)| <= 0.112 log T + 0.278 log log T + 2.510 (CJS/ANU 'improved upper bound II' line; 0.1013 log t asymptotic, Backlund-refined) - 6.66 at tPT2
Explicit |S(t)| (2024 state of the art family): |S(t)| <= 0.11 log t + 0.29 log log t + 2.29 (Cor. 1 of the arXiv 2412.15470 reference [20]) - 6.42 at tPT2

Improved R-vM (arXiv 2412.15470, Fiori appendix, 2024): |N(T) - (T/2pi)log(T/2pi e)| <= 0.10076 log T + 0.24460 log log T + 8.08344 (all T >= e) - asymptotically sharper, worse at t ~ 3e12 (O(8.08) dominates); subconvexity-driven, no S-sup gain at our heights
S-difference under RH (Conrey-Ghosh-Gonek): |S(T+H)-S(T)| <= (1/2+o(1)) log T/log log T, 0 < H <= sqrt(T) - 4.1 at 3e12, GROWING; conditional; wrong asymptotic for the decaying gate
Explicit 2nd/4th moments of S(t+h)-S(t), h << 1/log T (Trans 8571, unconditional) - mean-value/positive-proportion, not pointwise sup: structurally cannot feed the configuration-independent gate
Explicit extreme values of the argument in short intervals (arXiv 2510.14309, CJS 2025; Conrey-Turnage-Butterbaugh r-gaps improvement) - extreme-value statements, not uniform bounds
RH-conditional explicit S(t), S_1(t), zeta (Simonic, JNT 2021) - conditional, asymptotic constants, no pointwise gain at our t

2026 zero-free regions (arXiv 2603.21490: sigma >= 1 - 1/(4.896 log t), improving 5.559; and 55.241 (log t)^(2/3) (log log t)^(1/3) + 5.558691 log line) - right-edge only (sigma >= 0.993 at our t); the face at 0.125227 untouched
Small gaps paper (arXiv 2604.05733, 2026) - N_h(t) short-interval machinery (principal value); gap statements, not S-sup
decomposition: 5.00x published miss = 1.60x (first-moment wall, IRREDUCIBLE, ratio growing in t per 0278) x 3.1x (sup-overhead of explicit S constants above the first moment, the CG-class territory; in principle unengineerable for configuration-independent bounds)
verdict: S-route class EXHAUSTED (2026 literature). Face OPEN. No zero-free claim. NO RH CLAIM. Route (b) terminal - record sealed with 0281.
